models.note: Data: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai), free API tier; reach and price: models.dev catalog. Score = mean percentile over the job's metrics the model has. 'free' = cost 0 in the catalog or a rate-limited free-tier provider (groq, cerebras, nvidia). Price = catalog $/M tokens, blended 3:1. Tool-use metrics (tau2, Terminal-Bench, AutomationBench) are not in AA's free API tier, so 'tool use and agents' stays empty until we have AA Pro or measure tool calling ourselves.
